top_stories.title: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
top_stories.description: Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens. Android development is becoming agent-centric too. top_stories.title: AI detects “invisible” signs of pancreatic cancer years before diagnosis
top_stories.description: A powerful new AI system could help doctors detect pancreatic cancer years before it becomes visible on conventional scans. The technology, called REDMOD, identified hidden warning signs an average of 475 days before diagnosis and was nearly twice as sensitive as experienced radiologists. By spotting cancer-related changes at their earliest stages, it could dramatically improve the chances of successful treatment for one of the deadliest forms of cancer.

top_stories.title: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
top_stories.description: Google's stock dropped as much as ten percent after its quarterly earnings. Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion, but search revenue grew just 12 percent, slower than expected. Google acknowledged that its fast-growing AI mode brings in less revenue than traditional search, and it is now expanding its AI mode ad program internationally. The article Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe appeared first on The Decoder.

top_stories.description: Google LLC today debuted Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier large language model adept at complex programming tasks.
